comment: The section correctly frames DPI-H as an enduring capability rather than a completed project. However, it does not explicitly distinguish capital, recurrent, transition, refresh, and contingency costs.

anchor.note: p.102 l.Lines 542-545 read as the printed page; section 4.6 agrees

public.text: The section correctly frames DPI-H as an enduring capability rather than a completed project. However, it does not explicitly distinguish capital, recurrent, transition, refresh, and contingency costs.
public.suggestedRevision: Introduce a lifecycle-cost framework covering design, implementation, migration, operations, governance, support, licences, connectivity, security, training, testing, refresh, replacement, and decommissioning.
